title: Direct elimination puts the inverse 1-norm strictly between 281/100 and 282/100 (no new κ)
body:
## Summary
- At `p=19`, `beta0=-1/2`, bandwidth 2, and `t_i=i`, the same rational elimination of the normalized Schur section on `0,1,2,7,8,9` puts the inverse 1-norm strictly between `281/100` and `282/100`.
- The interval residual has 1-norm below `10^{-11}`. The certified norm is strictly below the Neumann ceiling `3938`, by a factor greater than `1396`.
- No new kappa is claimed. The selected record is unchanged. This is one normalized section, not an all-size inverse bound.
